implementation_scope: Replace the active upstream-contract workflow invocation with a bounded Rust xtask command. This is one O02 slice only; it does not complete O02 or retire historical Python sources.

historical_sources.disposition: Retained byte-identically as frozen migration evidence until separately reviewed F01/G08 source retirement.
Retained byte-identically as historical Python adapter regression evidence until separately reviewed source retirement.

former_invocation.behavior: Any manual dispatch invoked live probes; the weekly schedule was gated by LIVE_UPSTREAM_CONTRACTS=true.

current_invocation.manual_authorization: workflow_dispatch input run_live must be true; it defaults to false
current_invocation.scheduled_authorization: schedule event and repository variable LIVE_UPSTREAM_CONTRACTS=true

preserved_contract: The three fixed probes remain npm/typescript, OpenAlex/Attention Is All You Need, and crates.io/serde, requesting three results each.

Live mode permits only one HTTPS GET per exact host, path, and query set; default port 443; no URL credentials, fragment, request body, auth/cookie headers, proxy, retry, redirect, or content compression.
Each probe has a ten-second asynchronous deadline, identity-only response encoding, a 1 MiB response cap enforced before or during streaming, and a final-response URL check.
Reports distinguish passed, contract_failure, and upstream_unavailable; exit codes are 0, 1, and 2, with contract_failure taking precedence.
Reports include adapter status, result count, latency, HTTP status, adapter attempts, live wire requests, fixed bounds, and relevance_evaluated=false.
Captures are limited to successful probes and allowlisted public parser fields for the first three records; headers and personal author/publisher identities are omitted.
Adapter and transport diagnostics are replaced with fixed safe reason tokens; raw provider response bodies are never written to reports.
intentional_differences: The Rust command defaults to offline fixture replay and reports mode=offline_fixture with network_requests=0; live network access requires an explicit --live flag. The former Python command performed live probes when invoked.
The report adds mode and network_requests fields while retaining the prior report facts and exit semantics.
OpenAlex uses its native Rust adapter user agent. Identical request headers are not claimed.

verification.offline_report_observation: All three actual Rust adapters returned three usable results from committed fixtures, one adapter request each, zero network requests.

limitations_and_remaining_scope: The async ten-second deadline cancels send and body futures; synchronous adapter parsing is bounded by the 1 MiB response cap but cannot be preempted mid-poll by Tokio's cooperative timeout.
No hosted GitHub Actions run of the modified workflow was performed in this local slice; live providers and manual/scheduled workflow dispatch were not invoked.

Issue #919 remains open: its image-promotion workflow still uses an active Python writer; inline release helpers and remaining operational acceptance/ownership work are outside this upstream-probe slice; cargo xtask check O02 is not implemented here.
Historical Python helpers/tests/inventories remain frozen until their separate F01/G08 retirement acceptance; the backend and image runtime are not yet Python-free.
No SearXNG, portal, cache, authorization, ranking, or search API runtime behavior changed; this CI/tooling transition has no portal impact.
